requirements.description: Applicants must submit: (1) Updated CV – Highlighting relevant experience; (2) Technical Proposal (Brief) – Methods for engaging participants, previous experience with similar trainings, showing the field of expertise, soft skills, knowledge and technical literacy; (3) Quotation – The rate per training hour, inclusive of all costs (preparation, materials, transportation, etc.) and total estimated cost based on 5 days × 3 hours per day; (4) Availability Statement – Confirming availability to deliver the five (5)-days training.

requirements.description: Service category scope: Design Thinking Trainer shall be responsible for Advanced Training Delivery & Mentorship including Curriculum Facilitation on 6-session Design Thinking agenda focusing on Value Proposition Canvas (VPC) and 9-block Business Model Canvas (BMC); Methodological Instruction teaching specialized techniques including 'The Mom Test' for unbiased validation, Market Sizing (TAM/SAM/SOM), and '10-slide rule' for storytelling; Prototyping Supervision leading 'Prototyping Lab' helping students create Low-Fidelity MVPs (paper wireframes, storyboards, or physical mock-ups); Active Feedback providing continuous critical feedback during 'Daily Wrap-Up' sessions. Documentation includes Output Collection ensuring every team completes and submits mandatory deliverables for each session (e.g., Empathy Maps, Interview Scripts, Operational Flowcharts) and Reporting submitting final track report summarizing team progress, quality of prototypes developed, and readiness of each startup for pitching jury.

source_refs.excerpt: Scope of Work The Design Thinking Trainer shall be responsible for the following: A. Advanced Training Delivery & Mentorship - Curriculum Facilitation: Execute the 6-session Design Thinking agenda, focusing on the Value Proposition Canvas (VPC) and the full 9-block Business Model Canvas (BMC). - Methodological Instruction: Teach specialized techniques including 'The Mom Test' for unbiased validation, Market Sizing (TAM/SAM/SOM), and the '10-slide rule' for storytelling.

INJAZ Lebanon is a non-profit organization, an affiliate of Junior Achievement (JA) Worldwide, with a mission to equip youth with the skills and mindset they need to become entrepreneurs and business leaders stimulating their communities.
Reference: IL/GIL2026/PR0018- Trainer for Design Thinking
Subject: Trainer for Design Thinking
Please submit the following documents via email to applicant.one@example.org and applicant.two@example.org no later than October 30, 2026.
Terms of Reference (ToR) Request for Proposal (RFQ)
INJAZ Lebanon is seeking a highly skilled Design Thinking Trainer to lead a 6-session intensive track for youth aged 18–28.
Total estimated cost based on 5 days × 3 hours per day.
